name: QC Dashboard Annotator
description: Annotation tool for QC Dashboard - readKYC & readId

data_collection_permissions.disclosure_text: This extension stores annotation data locally on the user's device using browser.storage.local. No personal data is collected or transmitted to any external server. The only external network request is a Slack webhook alert for annotation pace monitoring, which contains only the annotator's self-entered name and anonymous ID.
